payload.summary_zh: GEOFlow 2.3.0 发布企业签名版默认官网模板、关于与归档页面，并为全新部署提供 50 篇版本化参考内容。
payload.summary_en: GEOFlow 2.3.0 publishes the Enterprise Signature default website theme, About and archive pages, and a versioned 50-article reference pack for fresh deployments.
payload.upgrade_tip_zh: 已有站点升级会保留原有主题、站点设置、分类与文章；参考内容只在全新空库首次执行 geoflow:install 时导入。升级后运行 php artisan migrate --force、php artisan geoflow:security-audit 并重启 queue worker；从较早安全版本升级时继续完成受管图片 readiness 与删除门禁检查。
payload.upgrade_tip_en: Existing sites keep their active theme, settings, categories, and articles. The reference pack is imported only by geoflow:install on a pristine database. After updating, run php artisan migrate --force and php artisan geoflow:security-audit, then restart queue workers. Upgrades from earlier security releases must complete managed-image deletion readiness checks.
